name: Download Bounce
description: Arrow repeatedly bounces into the tray — looping download progress indicator

variations.name: default
variations.description: Arrow continuously bounces down into the tray while download is in progress

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the loader in pixels

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the loader in pixels

props.name: color
props.description: Stroke color of the arrow and tray

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Stroke width of the SVG paths

props.name: isAnimating
props.description: Controls whether the bounce animation loops

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of one bounce cycle in seconds
